# LOGISTIC REGRESSION
# ============================================================
print("\nTraining Logistic Regression...")
lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0,
    penalty="l2",
    solver="saga",
    max_iter=1000,
    multi_class="multinomial",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    verbose=0,
)
lr_model.fit(train_sparse, y_train_labels)

lr_val_probs = lr_model.predict_proba(val_sparse)
lr_test_probs = lr_model.predict_proba(test_sparse)
print(
    f"Logistic Regression validation log loss: {compute_log_loss(y_val_labels, lr_val_probs):.4f}"
)

print(f"DeBERTa OOF Log Loss (full data unbiased): {oof_ll:.4f}")

# ============================================================
# ENSEMBLE WEIGHT OPTIMIZATION (Learned weighted average via logistic regression)
# ============================================================
print("\nOptimizing ensemble weights with learned weighted average...")
val_probas = {
    "deberta": deberta_val_probs,
    "xgboost": xgb_val_probs,
    "lr": lr_val_probs,
}

# Stack validation probabilities as features (3 models * 3 classes = 9 features)
X_ensemble = np.hstack([val_probas["deberta"], val_probas["xgboost"], val_probas["lr"]])
y_ensemble = y_val_labels

# Train logistic regression with no intercept and no penalty
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
lr_ensemble = LogisticRegression(
    penalty=None,
    fit_intercept=False,
    multi_class='multinomial',
    solver='lbfgs',
    max_iter=1000,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)
lr_ensemble.fit(X_ensemble, y_ensemble)

# Get coefficients and apply softmax to get per-model weights (average across classes)
coefs = lr_ensemble.coef_  # shape (3, 9) - 3 classes, 9 features (3 models * 3 classes)
# Average coefficients for each model across all classes
model_coefs = np.zeros(3)
for c in range(3):
    model_coefs[0] += coefs[c, 0:3].mean()
    model_coefs[1] += coefs[c, 3:6].mean()
    model_coefs[2] += coefs[c, 6:9].mean()
model_coefs /= 3  # average over classes

# Apply softmax to get weights
weights = np.exp(model_coefs) / np.exp(model_coefs).sum()
best_weights = {"deberta": weights[0], "xgboost": weights[1], "lr": weights[2]}

# Compute ensemble probabilities
ensemble_val_probs = (
    best_weights["deberta"] * val_probas["deberta"]
    + best_weights["xgboost"] * val_probas["xgboost"]
    + best_weights["lr"] * val_probas["lr"]
)
best_ll = compute_log_loss(y_val_labels, ensemble_val_probs)

print(f"Optimized ensemble weights (softmax of learned coefficients): {best_weights}")
print(f"Ensemble validation log loss: {best_ll:.4f}")

# ============================================================

    "deberta": deberta_test_probs,
    "xgboost": xgb_test_probs,
    "lr": lr_test_probs,
}
ensemble_test_probs = (
    best_weights["deberta"] * test_probas["deberta"]
    + best_weights["xgboost"] * test_probas["xgboost"]
    + best_weights["lr"] * test_probas["lr"]
)

eps = 1e-15
ensemble_test_probs = np.clip(ensemble_test_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
row_sums = ensemble_test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
ensemble_test_probs = ensemble_test_probs / row_sums
ensemble_test_probs = np.clip(ensemble_test_probs, eps, 1 - eps)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"].values,
        "EAP": ensemble_test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": ensemble_test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": ensemble_test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

submission_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_CSV, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {OUTPUT_CSV}")
print(submission_df.head())

# ============================================================
print(f"Final Validation Score: {best_ll}")

nodes.code_summary: The pipeline implements a multi-model ensemble for the Spooky Author Identification task. Data preprocessing includes label encoding of 3 authors (EAP, HPL, MWS) and train/validation split with stratification. Feature engineering extracts 30-dimensional stylometric features (word/sentence statistics, punctuation ratios, function/archaic/emotional word ratios), 4 readability metrics (Flesch Reading Ease, ARI, syllable counts), 5 POS-approximation features via suffix heuristics, and TF-IDF char/word n-grams (up to 7-grams) along with punctuation sequence patterns. The core deep learning model uses DeBERTa-v3-large fine-tuned with 5-fold cross-validation, label smoothing via standard cross-entropy, mixed-precision training, linear warmup scheduler, and early stopping. Extracted DeBERTa embeddings (mean-pooled last hidden layer) are combined with handcrafted features as inputs to an XGBoost classifier (500 trees, max_depth=8, early stopping). A separate Logistic Regression (multinomial, saga solver) is trained on sparse n-gram features. The ensemble uses learned softmax-weighted averaging via a no-intercept logistic regression on validation probabilities. Validation metric is multi-class log loss.

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():

        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# ============================================================
# Helper: Extract handcrafted features for a given text set
# ============================================================
def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_ngram_features(texts):
    """Extract all n-gram features for a set of texts."""
    char_short = char_vectorizer_short.transform(texts)
    char_med = char_vectorizer_med.transform(texts)
    char_long = char_vectorizer_long.transform(texts)
    word = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    punct_seqs = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in texts]
    punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(punct_seqs)
    sparse = hstack([char_short, char_med, char_long, word, punct]).tocsr()
    return sparse

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

# ============================================================
# HELPER: DeBERTa training function for one fold
# ============================================================
def train_deberta_fold(train_idx, val_idx, fold):
    """Train DeBERTa on one fold, extract mean-pooled embeddings and probabilities."""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/{N_FOLDS}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    # Split data
    fold_train_texts = X_full_texts[train_idx]
    fold_val_texts = X_full_texts[val_idx]
    fold_y_train = y_full_labels[train_idx]
    fold_y_val = y_full_labels[val_idx]

    # Tokenize for this fold
    fold_train_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_train_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    fold_val_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_val_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

    # Create DataLoaders
    fold_train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_train_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_train_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_train, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    fold_val_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_val_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_val_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_val, dtype=torch.long),
    )

    fold_train_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    fold_val_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model for this fold (no MixUp, no label smoothing)
    fold_model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_NAME,
        num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS,
        hidden_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
        attention_probs_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
    )
    fold_model.to(device)

    total_steps = len(fold_train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )
    scaler = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

    best_val_loss = float('inf')
    best_epoch = -1
    patience_counter = 0
    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        fold_model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        num_batches = 0
        for batch in fold_train_loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
                )
                loss = outputs.loss
            if scaler is not None:
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
            num_batches += 1
        avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

        # Evaluate on validation set (deterministic, no MC Dropout)
        fold_model.eval()
        all_val_probs = []
        all_val_labels = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in fold_val_loader:
                b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
                b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
                b_labels = batch[2].to(device)
                with autocast():
                    outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                    probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(b_labels.cpu().numpy())
        val_probs = np.vstack(all_val_probs)
        val_labels = np.concatenate(all_val_labels)
        val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)
        val_acc = np.mean(np.argmax(val_probs, axis=1) == val_labels)
        print(f"  Epoch {epoch+1}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f} | Val Acc: {val_acc:.4f}")

        # Early stopping check with patience 3
        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch
            patience_counter = 0
            torch.save(fold_model.state_dict(), f'{WORKING_DIR}/best_model_fold_{fold+1}.pt')
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= 3:
                print(f"  Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}, best epoch: {best_epoch+1}")
                # Reload best checkpoint
                fold_model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f'{WORKING_DIR}/best_model_fold_{fold+1}.pt'))
                break

    # Extract mean-pooled embeddings for train and val sets of this fold
    with torch.no_grad():
        train_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_train_enc["input_ids"], fold_train_enc["attention_mask"]
        )
        val_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_val_enc["input_ids"], fold_val_enc["attention_mask"]
        )

    # Get probabilities for ensemble
    # Train probabilities
    fold_train_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(fold_train_texts), BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = fold_train_enc["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = fold_train_enc["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_train_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_train_probs = np.vstack(fold_train_probs_list)

    # Val probabilities
    fold_val_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in fold_val_loader:
            b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_val_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_val_probs = np.vstack(fold_val_probs_list)

    # Test probabilities (same for all folds)
    test_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, test_df.shape[0], BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = test_encodings["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = test_encodings["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            test_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_test_probs = np.vstack(test_probs_list)

    # Clean up
    del fold_model
    gc.collect()
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return train_emb, val_emb, fold_train_probs, fold_val_probs, fold_test_probs

# Initialize arrays to accumulate fold probabilities (OOF-style)

## 🚨 MODEL ARCHITECTURE SAFETY (Prevent Runtime Crashes)

- 
- ⚠️ **Critical**: When modifying a pre-trained model architecture (e.g., adding attention pooling, custom heads, wrapper classes),
- you MUST ensure checkpoint loading is compatible. This is the #1 cause of runtime crashes.
- 
- ❌ **FATAL PATTERN (will crash at runtime):**
- ```python

- 
- # 2. Train and save: torch.save(model.state_dict(), path)
- 
- # 3. Later, load checkpoint with strict=True → CRASH!
- #    Keys like 'attention_pool.weight' don't exist in old checkpoint

- ```
- 
- ✅ **SAFE APPROACHES:**
- 
- **Option A (Recommended): Don't change model class. Use standard AutoModelForSequenceClassification and extract embeddings via outputs.hidden_states.**
- This avoids checkpoint incompatibility entirely.
- 
- **Option B: If you must modify architecture, use filtered loading:**
- ```python
- state_dict = torch.load(path, map_location=device)
- model_state = model.state_dict()
- filtered = {k: v for k, v in state_dict.items() if k in model_state and v.shape == model_state[k].shape}
- model.load_state_dict(filtered, strict=False)
- print(f'Loaded {len(filtered)}/{len(model_state)} parameters from checkpoint')
- ```
- 
- **Option C: If using attention pooling, implement it OUTSIDE the model class as a post-processing step on CLS embeddings instead of adding it as a model layer.**

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )

        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:

        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:

            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]

            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

# ============================================================
# HELPER: DeBERTa training function for one fold
# ============================================================
def train_deberta_fold(train_idx, val_idx, fold):
    """Train DeBERTa on one fold, extract mean-pooled embeddings and probabilities."""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/{N_FOLDS}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    # Split data
    fold_train_texts = X_full_texts[train_idx]
    fold_val_texts = X_full_texts[val_idx]
    fold_y_train = y_full_labels[train_idx]
    fold_y_val = y_full_labels[val_idx]

    # Tokenize for this fold
    fold_train_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_train_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    fold_val_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_val_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

    # Create DataLoaders
    fold_train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_train_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_train_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_train, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    fold_val_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_val_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_val_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_val, dtype=torch.long),
    )

    fold_train_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    fold_val_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model for this fold (no MixUp, no label smoothing)
    fold_model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_NAME,
        num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS,
        hidden_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
        attention_probs_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
    )
    fold_model.to(device)

    total_steps = len(fold_train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )
    scaler = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        fold_model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        num_batches = 0
        for batch in fold_train_loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
                )
                loss = outputs.loss
            if scaler is not None:
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
            num_batches += 1
        avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

        # Evaluate on validation set (deterministic, no MC Dropout)
        fold_model.eval()
        all_val_probs = []
        all_val_labels = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in fold_val_loader:
                b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
                b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
                b_labels = batch[2].to(device)
                with autocast():
                    outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                    probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(b_labels.cpu().numpy())
        val_probs = np.vstack(all_val_probs)
        val_labels = np.concatenate(all_val_labels)
        val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)
        val_acc = np.mean(np.argmax(val_probs, axis=1) == val_labels)
        print(f"  Epoch {epoch+1}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f} | Val Acc: {val_acc:.4f}")

    # Extract mean-pooled embeddings for train and val sets of this fold
    fold_model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        train_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_train_enc["input_ids"], fold_train_enc["attention_mask"]
        )
        val_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_val_enc["input_ids"], fold_val_enc["attention_mask"]
        )

    # Get probabilities for ensemble
    fold_model.eval()
    # Train probabilities
    fold_train_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(fold_train_texts), BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = fold_train_enc["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = fold_train_enc["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_train_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_train_probs = np.vstack(fold_train_probs_list)

    # Val probabilities
    fold_val_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in fold_val_loader:
            b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_val_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_val_probs = np.vstack(fold_val_probs_list)

    # Test probabilities (same for all folds)
    test_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, test_df.shape[0], BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = test_encodings["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = test_encodings["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            test_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_test_probs = np.vstack(test_probs_list)

    # Clean up
    del fold_model
    gc.collect()
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return train_emb, val_emb, fold_train_probs, fold_val_probs, fold_test_probs

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: 5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION TRAINING
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION DEBERTA TRAINING")
print("=" * 60)

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)

# Initialize arrays to accumulate fold probabilities (OOF-style)
train_indices = np.arange(len(X_full_texts))
all_fold_train_probs = np.zeros((len(X_full_texts), NUM_AUTHORS))
all_fold_val_probs = np.zeros((len(X_full_texts), NUM_AUTHORS))
all_fold_test_probs = np.zeros((test_df.shape[0], NUM_AUTHORS))
train_oof_embeddings = np.zeros((len(X_full_texts), 1024))
count_oof = np.zeros(len(X_full_texts))

fold_idx = 0
for train_idx, val_idx in skf.split(train_indices, y_full_labels):
    train_emb, val_emb, train_probs, val_probs, test_probs = train_deberta_fold(train_idx, val_idx, fold_idx)

    # Accumulate train embeddings (only for training data used in this fold)
    train_oof_embeddings[train_idx] += train_emb
    count_oof[train_idx] += 1

    # Store OOF validation probabilities
    all_fold_val_probs[val_idx] = val_probs

    # Store train probabilities (for refit model later)
    all_fold_train_probs[train_idx] += train_probs

    # Accumulate test probabilities (average across folds)
    all_fold_test_probs += test_probs

    fold_idx += 1

# Average test probabilities
all_fold_test_probs /= N_FOLDS

# Average train embeddings
train_oof_embeddings = train_oof_embeddings / count_oof[:, np.newaxis]

# Get OOF validation labels (properly aligned with OOF predictions)
val_preds_list = []
val_labels_list = []
for _, val_idx in skf.split(train_indices, y_full_labels):
    val_preds_list.append(all_fold_val_probs[val_idx])
    val_labels_list.append(y_full_labels[val_idx])
oof_val_probs = np.vstack(val_preds_list)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# Helper: Extract handcrafted features for a given text set
# ============================================================
def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_ngram_features(texts):
    """Extract all n-gram features for a set of texts."""
    char_short = char_vectorizer_short.transform(texts)
    char_med = char_vectorizer_med.transform(texts)
    char_long = char_vectorizer_long.transform(texts)
    word = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    punct_seqs = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in texts]
    punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(punct_seqs)
    sparse = hstack([char_short, char_med, char_long, word, punct]).tocsr()
    return sparse

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

    )

    )

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

where N is the number of observations in the test set, M is the number of class labels (3 classes), \\(log\\) is the natural logarithm, \\(y_{ij}\\) is 1 if observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\) and 0 otherwise, and \\(p_{ij}\\) is the predicted probability that observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\).

The submitted probabilities for a given sentences are not required to sum to one because they are rescaled prior to being scored (each row is divided by the row sum). In order to avoid the extremes of the log function, predicted probabilities are replaced with \\(max(min(p,1-10^{-15}),10^{-15})\\).

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_ngram_features(texts):
    """Extract all n-gram features for a set of texts."""
    char_short = char_vectorizer_short.transform(texts)
    char_med = char_vectorizer_med.transform(texts)
    char_long = char_vectorizer_long.transform(texts)
    word = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    punct_seqs = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in texts]
    punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(punct_seqs)
    sparse = hstack([char_short, char_med, char_long, word, punct]).tocsr()
    return sparse

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

# HELPER: DeBERTa training function for one fold
# ============================================================
def train_deberta_fold(train_idx, val_idx, fold):
    """Train DeBERTa on one fold, extract mean-pooled embeddings and probabilities."""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/{N_FOLDS}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    # Split data
    fold_train_texts = X_full_texts[train_idx]
    fold_val_texts = X_full_texts[val_idx]
    fold_y_train = y_full_labels[train_idx]
    fold_y_val = y_full_labels[val_idx]

    # Tokenize for this fold
    fold_train_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_train_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    fold_val_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_val_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

    # Create DataLoaders
    fold_train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_train_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_train_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_train, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    fold_val_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_val_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_val_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_val, dtype=torch.long),
    )

    fold_train_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    fold_val_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model for this fold (no MixUp, no label smoothing)
    fold_model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_NAME,
        num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS,
        hidden_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
        attention_probs_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
    )
    fold_model.to(device)

    total_steps = len(fold_train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)

        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# ============================================================
# Helper: Extract handcrafted features for a given text set
# ============================================================
def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_ngram_features(texts):
    """Extract all n-gram features for a set of texts."""
    char_short = char_vectorizer_short.transform(texts)
    char_med = char_vectorizer_med.transform(texts)
    char_long = char_vectorizer_long.transform(texts)
    word = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    punct_seqs = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in texts]
    punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(punct_seqs)
    sparse = hstack([char_short, char_med, char_long, word, punct]).tocsr()
    return sparse

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])
