# ============================================================
# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

# ============================================================
# HELPER: DeBERTa training function for one fold
# ============================================================
def train_deberta_fold(train_idx, val_idx, fold):
    """Train DeBERTa on one fold, extract mean-pooled embeddings and probabilities."""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/{N_FOLDS}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    # Split data
    fold_train_texts = X_full_texts[train_idx]
    fold_val_texts = X_full_texts[val_idx]
    fold_y_train = y_full_labels[train_idx]
    fold_y_val = y_full_labels[val_idx]

    # Tokenize for this fold
    fold_train_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_train_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    fold_val_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_val_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

    # Create DataLoaders
    fold_train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_train_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_train_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_train, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    fold_val_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_val_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_val_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_val, dtype=torch.long),
    )

    fold_train_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    fold_val_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model for this fold (no MixUp, no label smoothing)
    fold_model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_NAME,
        num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS,
        hidden_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
        attention_probs_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
    )
    fold_model.to(device)

    total_steps = len(fold_train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )
    scaler = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

    best_val_loss = float('inf')
    best_epoch = -1
    patience_counter = 0
    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        fold_model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        num_batches = 0
        for batch in fold_train_loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
                )
                loss = outputs.loss
            if scaler is not None:
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
            num_batches += 1
        avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

        # Evaluate on validation set (deterministic, no MC Dropout)
        fold_model.eval()
        all_val_probs = []
        all_val_labels = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in fold_val_loader:
                b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
                b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
                b_labels = batch[2].to(device)
                with autocast():
                    outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                    probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(b_labels.cpu().numpy())
        val_probs = np.vstack(all_val_probs)
        val_labels = np.concatenate(all_val_labels)
        val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)
        val_acc = np.mean(np.argmax(val_probs, axis=1) == val_labels)
        print(f"  Epoch {epoch+1}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f} | Val Acc: {val_acc:.4f}")

        # Early stopping check with patience 3
        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch
            patience_counter = 0
            torch.save(fold_model.state_dict(), f'{WORKING_DIR}/best_model_fold_{fold+1}.pt')
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= 3:
                print(f"  Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}, best epoch: {best_epoch+1}")
                # Reload best checkpoint
                fold_model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f'{WORKING_DIR}/best_model_fold_{fold+1}.pt'))
                break

    # Extract mean-pooled embeddings for train and val sets of this fold
    with torch.no_grad():
        train_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_train_enc["input_ids"], fold_train_enc["attention_mask"]
        )
        val_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_val_enc["input_ids"], fold_val_enc["attention_mask"]
        )

    # Get probabilities for ensemble
    # Train probabilities
    fold_train_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(fold_train_texts), BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = fold_train_enc["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = fold_train_enc["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_train_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_train_probs = np.vstack(fold_train_probs_list)

    # Val probabilities
    fold_val_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in fold_val_loader:
            b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_val_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_val_probs = np.vstack(fold_val_probs_list)

    # Test probabilities (same for all folds)
    test_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, test_df.shape[0], BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = test_encodings["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = test_encodings["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            test_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_test_probs = np.vstack(test_probs_list)

    # Clean up
    del fold_model
    gc.collect()
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return train_emb, val_emb, fold_train_probs, fold_val_probs, fold_test_probs

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_ngram_features(texts):
    """Extract all n-gram features for a set of texts."""
    char_short = char_vectorizer_short.transform(texts)
    char_med = char_vectorizer_med.transform(texts)
    char_long = char_vectorizer_long.transform(texts)
    word = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    punct_seqs = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in texts]
    punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(punct_seqs)
    sparse = hstack([char_short, char_med, char_long, word, punct]).tocsr()
    return sparse

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

# HELPER: DeBERTa training function for one fold
# ============================================================
def train_deberta_fold(train_idx, val_idx, fold):
    """Train DeBERTa on one fold, extract mean-pooled embeddings and probabilities."""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/{N_FOLDS}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    # Split data
    fold_train_texts = X_full_texts[train_idx]
    fold_val_texts = X_full_texts[val_idx]
    fold_y_train = y_full_labels[train_idx]
    fold_y_val = y_full_labels[val_idx]

    # Tokenize for this fold
    fold_train_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_train_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    fold_val_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_val_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

    # Create DataLoaders
    fold_train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_train_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_train_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_train, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    fold_val_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_val_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_val_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_val, dtype=torch.long),
    )

    fold_train_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    fold_val_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model for this fold (no MixUp, no label smoothing)
    fold_model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_NAME,
        num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS,
        hidden_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
        attention_probs_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
    )
    fold_model.to(device)

    total_steps = len(fold_train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )
    scaler = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

    best_val_loss = float('inf')
    best_epoch = -1
    patience_counter = 0
    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        fold_model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        num_batches = 0
        for batch in fold_train_loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
                )
                loss = outputs.loss
            if scaler is not None:
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
            num_batches += 1
        avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

        # Evaluate on validation set (deterministic, no MC Dropout)
        fold_model.eval()
        all_val_probs = []
        all_val_labels = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in fold_val_loader:
                b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
                b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
                b_labels = batch[2].to(device)
                with autocast():
                    outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                    probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(b_labels.cpu().numpy())
        val_probs = np.vstack(all_val_probs)
        val_labels = np.concatenate(all_val_labels)
        val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)
        val_acc = np.mean(np.argmax(val_probs, axis=1) == val_labels)
        print(f"  Epoch {epoch+1}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f} | Val Acc: {val_acc:.4f}")

        # Early stopping check with patience 3
        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch
            patience_counter = 0
            torch.save(fold_model.state_dict(), f'{WORKING_DIR}/best_model_fold_{fold+1}.pt')
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= 3:
                print(f"  Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}, best epoch: {best_epoch+1}")
                # Reload best checkpoint
                fold_model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f'{WORKING_DIR}/best_model_fold_{fold+1}.pt'))
                break

    # Extract mean-pooled embeddings for train and val sets of this fold
    with torch.no_grad():
        train_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_train_enc["input_ids"], fold_train_enc["attention_mask"]
        )
        val_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_val_enc["input_ids"], fold_val_enc["attention_mask"]
        )

    # Get probabilities for ensemble
    # Train probabilities
    fold_train_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(fold_train_texts), BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = fold_train_enc["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = fold_train_enc["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_train_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_train_probs = np.vstack(fold_train_probs_list)

    # Val probabilities
    fold_val_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in fold_val_loader:
            b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_val_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_val_probs = np.vstack(fold_val_probs_list)

    # Test probabilities (same for all folds)
    test_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, test_df.shape[0], BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = test_encodings["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = test_encodings["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            test_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_test_probs = np.vstack(test_probs_list)

    # Clean up
    del fold_model
    gc.collect()
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return train_emb, val_emb, fold_train_probs, fold_val_probs, fold_test_probs

    np.arange(len(X_full_texts)),
    test_size=0.1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    stratify=y_full_labels
)

    list(X_full_texts[val_idx]),

)

    TensorDataset(

    num_workers=2,

    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,

)

    {
        "params": [p for n, p in deberta_model.named_parameters() if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)],
        "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
    },

        "params": [p for n, p in deberta_model.named_parameters() if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)],
        "weight_decay": 0.0,
    },
]

    num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),

        with autocast():

        if scaler is not None:

            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(deberta_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
        else:

            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(deberta_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# ============================================================
# Helper: Extract handcrafted features for a given text set
# ============================================================
def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_ngram_features(texts):
    """Extract all n-gram features for a set of texts."""
    char_short = char_vectorizer_short.transform(texts)
    char_med = char_vectorizer_med.transform(texts)
    char_long = char_vectorizer_long.transform(texts)
    word = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    punct_seqs = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in texts]
    punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(punct_seqs)
    sparse = hstack([char_short, char_med, char_long, word, punct]).tocsr()
    return sparse

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Fit handcrafted feature extractors on a given text set
# ============================================================
def fit_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Fit and return scaler for handcrafted features (no leakage)."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaler.fit(hf)
    return scaler

def transform_handcrafted_features(texts, scaler):
    """Transform texts using pre-fitted scaler."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    return scaler.transform(hf)

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):

    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)

- ⚠️ **Critical**: When modifying a pre-trained model architecture (e.g., adding attention pooling, custom heads, wrapper classes),

- ❌ **FATAL PATTERN (will crash at runtime):**
- ```python

- self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)

- ...
- 
- # 2. Train and save: torch.save(model.state_dict(), path)
- 
- # 3. Later, load checkpoint with strict=True → CRASH!
- #    Keys like 'attention_pool.weight' don't exist in old checkpoint
- model.load_state_dict(torch.load(path))  # RuntimeError: unexpected key!
- ```
- 
- ✅ **SAFE APPROACHES:**
- 
- **Option A (Recommended): Don't change model class. Use standard AutoModelForSequenceClassification and extract embeddings via outputs.hidden_states.**
- This avoids checkpoint incompatibility entirely.
- 
- **Option B: If you must modify architecture, use filtered loading:**
- ```python
- state_dict = torch.load(path, map_location=device)
- model_state = model.state_dict()
- filtered = {k: v for k, v in state_dict.items() if k in model_state and v.shape == model_state[k].shape}
- model.load_state_dict(filtered, strict=False)
- print(f'Loaded {len(filtered)}/{len(model_state)} parameters from checkpoint')
- ```
- 
- **Option C: If using attention pooling, implement it OUTSIDE the model class as a post-processing step on CLS embeddings instead of adding it as a model layer.**

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_ngram_features(texts):
    """Extract all n-gram features for a set of texts."""
    char_short = char_vectorizer_short.transform(texts)
    char_med = char_vectorizer_med.transform(texts)
    char_long = char_vectorizer_long.transform(texts)
    word = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    punct_seqs = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in texts]
    punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(punct_seqs)
    sparse = hstack([char_short, char_med, char_long, word, punct]).tocsr()
    return sparse

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

# HELPER: DeBERTa training function for one fold
# ============================================================
def train_deberta_fold(train_idx, val_idx, fold):
    """Train DeBERTa on one fold, extract mean-pooled embeddings and probabilities."""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/{N_FOLDS}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    # Split data
    fold_train_texts = X_full_texts[train_idx]
    fold_val_texts = X_full_texts[val_idx]
    fold_y_train = y_full_labels[train_idx]
    fold_y_val = y_full_labels[val_idx]

    # Tokenize for this fold
    fold_train_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_train_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    fold_val_enc = tokenizer(
        list(fold_val_texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

    # Create DataLoaders
    fold_train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_train_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_train_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_train, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    fold_val_dataset = TensorDataset(
        fold_val_enc["input_ids"],
        fold_val_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(fold_y_val, dtype=torch.long),
    )

    fold_train_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    fold_val_loader = DataLoader(
        fold_val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model for this fold (no MixUp, no label smoothing)
    fold_model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_NAME,
        num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS,
        hidden_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
        attention_probs_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
    )
    fold_model.to(device)

    total_steps = len(fold_train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in fold_model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )
    scaler = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

    best_val_loss = float('inf')
    best_epoch = -1
    patience_counter = 0
    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        fold_model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        num_batches = 0
        for batch in fold_train_loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
                )
                loss = outputs.loss
            if scaler is not None:
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(fold_model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
            num_batches += 1
        avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

        # Evaluate on validation set (deterministic, no MC Dropout)
        fold_model.eval()
        all_val_probs = []
        all_val_labels = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in fold_val_loader:
                b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
                b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
                b_labels = batch[2].to(device)
                with autocast():
                    outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                    probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(b_labels.cpu().numpy())
        val_probs = np.vstack(all_val_probs)
        val_labels = np.concatenate(all_val_labels)
        val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)
        val_acc = np.mean(np.argmax(val_probs, axis=1) == val_labels)
        print(f"  Epoch {epoch+1}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f} | Val Acc: {val_acc:.4f}")

        # Early stopping check with patience 3
        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch
            patience_counter = 0
            torch.save(fold_model.state_dict(), f'{WORKING_DIR}/best_model_fold_{fold+1}.pt')
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= 3:
                print(f"  Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}, best epoch: {best_epoch+1}")
                # Reload best checkpoint
                fold_model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f'{WORKING_DIR}/best_model_fold_{fold+1}.pt'))
                break

    # Extract mean-pooled embeddings for train and val sets of this fold
    with torch.no_grad():
        train_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_train_enc["input_ids"], fold_train_enc["attention_mask"]
        )
        val_emb = extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(
            fold_model, fold_val_enc["input_ids"], fold_val_enc["attention_mask"]
        )

    # Get probabilities for ensemble
    # Train probabilities
    fold_train_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(fold_train_texts), BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = fold_train_enc["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = fold_train_enc["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_train_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_train_probs = np.vstack(fold_train_probs_list)

    # Val probabilities
    fold_val_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in fold_val_loader:
            b_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            fold_val_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_val_probs = np.vstack(fold_val_probs_list)

    # Test probabilities (same for all folds)
    test_probs_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, test_df.shape[0], BATCH_SIZE * 2):
            b_ids = test_encodings["input_ids"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            b_mask = test_encodings["attention_mask"][i:i+BATCH_SIZE*2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = fold_model(input_ids=b_ids, attention_mask=b_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            test_probs_list.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    fold_test_probs = np.vstack(test_probs_list)

    # Clean up
    del fold_model
    gc.collect()
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return train_emb, val_emb, fold_train_probs, fold_val_probs, fold_test_probs

    word = word.lower()
    count = 0
    vowels = "aeiouy"
    if word and word[0] in vowels:

    for i in range(1, len(word)):
        if word[i] in vowels and word[i - 1] not in vowels:

    if word.endswith("e"):

    if word.endswith("le") and len(word) > 2:

    if count == 0:

    avg_syllables = syllable_count / len(words)
    avg_words_per_sentence = len(words) / len(sentences)
    score = 206.835 - 1.015 * avg_words_per_sentence - 84.6 * avg_syllables
    return max(0, min(100, score))

def automated_readability_index(text):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0.0
    sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
    sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
    if len(sentences) == 0:
        return 0.0
    char_count = sum(len(w) for w in words)
    ari = 4.71 * (char_count / len(words)) + 0.5 * (len(words) / len(sentences)) - 21.43
    return max(0, ari)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0] * 30)
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        sent_count = len(sentences) if len(sentences) > 0 else 1
        word_count = len(words)
        text_len = len(text)
        avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        avg_sent_len = word_count / sent_count
        upper_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        lower_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.islower()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        digit_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isdigit()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        whitespace_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isspace()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        punct_chars = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        punct_ratios = [
            text.count(p) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0 for p in punct_chars
        ]
        char_diversity = len(set(text.lower())) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        long_words_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        )
        capitalized_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isupper()) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        all_caps_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        sent_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
        sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0
        sent_len_var = np.var(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0
        words_lower = [w.lower() for w in words]
        function_word_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in FUNCTION_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        archaic_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        emotional_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        lovecraft_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        feat = [
            text_len,
            word_count,
            sent_count,
            avg_word_len,
            avg_sent_len,
            upper_ratio,
            lower_ratio,
            digit_ratio,
            whitespace_ratio,
            *punct_ratios,
            char_diversity,
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 2),
            long_words_ratio,
            capitalized_ratio,
            all_caps_ratio,
            sent_len_std,
            sent_len_var,
            function_word_ratio,
            archaic_ratio,
            emotional_ratio,
            lovecraft_ratio,
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)

def create_readability_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        flesch = flesch_reading_ease(text)
        ari = automated_readability_index(text)
        avg_syllables = np.mean([count_syllables(w) for w in words])
        complex_words = sum(1 for w in words if count_syllables(w) > 2)
        complex_ratio = complex_words / len(words)
        features.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_ratio])
    return np.array(features)

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    noun_suffixes = [
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ance",
        "ence",
        "ship",
        "dom",
        "hood",
    ]
    verb_suffixes = ["ed", "ing", "ate", "ize", "ify", "en", "ish"]
    adj_suffixes = [
        "ous",
        "ful",
        "ic",
        "al",
        "ive",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "less",
        "ish",
        "like",
    ]
    adv_suffixes = ["ly", "ward", "wise", "ways"]
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        noun_ratio = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in noun_suffixes)
        ) / len(words)
        verb_ratio = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in verb_suffixes)
        ) / len(words)
        adj_ratio = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in adj_suffixes)
        ) / len(words)
        adv_ratio = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in adv_suffixes)
        ) / len(words)
        words_lower = [w.lower() for w in words]
        content_words = [
            w for w in words_lower if len(w) > 3 and w not in FUNCTION_WORDS
        ]
        content_ratio = len(content_words) / len(words)
        features.append([noun_ratio, verb_ratio, adj_ratio, adv_ratio, content_ratio])
    return np.array(features)

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# METRIC: Multi-class Log Loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# Reusable evaluate function (no labels optional)
def evaluate_deberta_probs(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size):
    model.eval()
    all_probs = []
    dataset = TensorDataset(input_ids, attention_mask)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            b_input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(input_ids=b_input_ids, attention_mask=b_attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            all_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(all_probs)

def evaluate_deberta_with_labels(model, input_ids, attention_mask, labels, batch_size):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []
    dataset = TensorDataset(input_ids, attention_mask, labels)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            b_input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            b_labels = batch[2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(input_ids=b_input_ids, attention_mask=b_attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            all_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(b_labels.cpu().numpy())
    all_preds = np.vstack(all_preds)
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)
    logloss = compute_log_loss(all_labels, all_preds)
    acc = np.mean(np.argmax(all_preds, axis=1) == all_labels)
    return logloss, acc, all_preds

scaler_grad = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

for fold, (train_fold_idx, val_fold_idx) in enumerate(fold_splits):

    total_steps = len(train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_epoch = 0
    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        num_batches = 0
        for batch in train_loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
                )
                loss = outputs.loss
            if scaler_grad is not None:
                scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
                scaler_grad.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
            num_batches += 1
        avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches
        val_loss, val_acc, _ = evaluate_deberta_with_labels(
            model, fold_val_ids, fold_val_mask, fold_val_labels, BATCH_SIZE * 2
        )

        )
        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch + 1
            patience_counter = 0
            torch.save(
                model.state_dict(), os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, f"best_deberta_fold{fold}.pt")
            )
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= PATIENCE:
                print(
                    f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}. Best epoch: {best_epoch}, Best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}"
                )
                break

    print(f"\nFold {fold+1} best: epoch {best_epoch}, val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}")

    # Load best checkpoint for this fold
    model.load_state_dict(
        torch.load(os.path.join(WORKING_DIR, f"best_deberta_fold{fold}.pt"), map_location=device)
    )

    # Generate OOF predictions for this fold's validation indices

    )

    # Clear CUDA cache

    gc.collect()

def count_syllables(word):
    word = word.lower()
    count = 0
    vowels = "aeiouy"
    if word and word[0] in vowels:
        count += 1
    for i in range(1, len(word)):
        if word[i] in vowels and word[i - 1] not in vowels:
            count += 1
    if word.endswith("e"):
        count -= 1
    if word.endswith("le") and len(word) > 2:
        count += 1
    if count == 0:
        count = 1
    return count

def flesch_reading_ease(text):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0.0
    sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
    sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
    if len(sentences) == 0:
        return 0.0
    syllable_count = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
    avg_syllables = syllable_count / len(words)
    avg_words_per_sentence = len(words) / len(sentences)
    score = 206.835 - 1.015 * avg_words_per_sentence - 84.6 * avg_syllables
    return max(0, min(100, score))

def automated_readability_index(text):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0.0
    sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
    sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
    if len(sentences) == 0:
        return 0.0
    char_count = sum(len(w) for w in words)
    ari = 4.71 * (char_count / len(words)) + 0.5 * (len(words) / len(sentences)) - 21.43
    return max(0, ari)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0] * 30)
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        sent_count = len(sentences) if len(sentences) > 0 else 1
        word_count = len(words)
        text_len = len(text)
        avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        avg_sent_len = word_count / sent_count
        upper_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        lower_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.islower()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        digit_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isdigit()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        whitespace_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isspace()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        punct_chars = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        punct_ratios = [
            text.count(p) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0 for p in punct_chars
        ]
        char_diversity = len(set(text.lower())) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        long_words_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        )
        capitalized_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isupper()) / word_count

            else 0
        )
        all_caps_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        sent_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
        sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0
        sent_len_var = np.var(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0
        words_lower = [w.lower() for w in words]
        function_word_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in FUNCTION_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        archaic_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        emotional_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        lovecraft_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        feat = [
            text_len,
            word_count,
            sent_count,
            avg_word_len,
            avg_sent_len,
            upper_ratio,
            lower_ratio,
            digit_ratio,
            whitespace_ratio,
            *punct_ratios,
            char_diversity,
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 2),

            all_caps_ratio,
            sent_len_std,
            sent_len_var,
            function_word_ratio,
            archaic_ratio,
            emotional_ratio,
            lovecraft_ratio,
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)

def create_readability_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:

        text = str(text)

        features.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_ratio])
    return np.array(features)

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

def evaluate_deberta_probs(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size):
    model.eval()
    all_probs = []
    dataset = TensorDataset(input_ids, attention_mask)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True)
    with torch.no_grad():

            b_attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(input_ids=b_input_ids, attention_mask=b_attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            all_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(all_probs)

def evaluate_deberta_with_labels(model, input_ids, attention_mask, labels, batch_size):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []
    dataset = TensorDataset(input_ids, attention_mask, labels)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            b_input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            b_labels = batch[2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(input_ids=b_input_ids, attention_mask=b_attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            all_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(b_labels.cpu().numpy())
    all_preds = np.vstack(all_preds)
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)
    logloss = compute_log_loss(all_labels, all_preds)
    acc = np.mean(np.argmax(all_preds, axis=1) == all_labels)
    return logloss, acc, all_preds

def extract_embeddings(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    with torch.no_grad():
