def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:

            if vowel_groups == 0:

            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]

        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))

        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# Helper: Extract handcrafted features for a given text set
# ============================================================
def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):

    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens

def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
def fit_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Fit and return scaler for handcrafted features (no leakage)."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaler.fit(hf)

def transform_handcrafted_features(texts, scaler):
    """Transform texts using pre-fitted scaler."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    return scaler.transform(hf)

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# ============================================================
# Helper: Extract handcrafted features for a given text set
# ============================================================
def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_ngram_features(texts):
    """Extract all n-gram features for a set of texts."""
    char_short = char_vectorizer_short.transform(texts)
    char_med = char_vectorizer_med.transform(texts)
    char_long = char_vectorizer_long.transform(texts)
    word = word_vectorizer.transform(texts)
    punct_seqs = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in texts]
    punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(punct_seqs)
    sparse = hstack([char_short, char_med, char_long, word, punct]).tocsr()
    return sparse

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Fit handcrafted feature extractors on a given text set
# ============================================================
def fit_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Fit and return scaler for handcrafted features (no leakage)."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaler.fit(hf)
    return scaler

def transform_handcrafted_features(texts, scaler):
    """Transform texts using pre-fitted scaler."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    return scaler.transform(hf)

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# Helper: Extract handcrafted features for a given text set
# ============================================================
def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):

# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
def fit_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Fit and return scaler for handcrafted features (no leakage)."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaler.fit(hf)

    """Transform texts using pre-fitted scaler."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    return scaler.transform(hf)

# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
def fit_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Fit and return scaler for handcrafted features (no leakage)."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaler.fit(hf)
    return scaler

def transform_handcrafted_features(texts, scaler):
    """Transform texts using pre-fitted scaler."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    return scaler.transform(hf)

# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

- DeBERTa-v3-large fine-tuning with label smoothing
- Handcrafted stylometric/readability/POS features
- Character/word n-gram features via TF-IDF

- Logistic Regression on sparse n-gram features
- Weighted ensemble with grid-search optimization

def count_syllables(word):
    word = word.lower()
    count = 0
    vowels = "aeiouy"
    if word and word[0] in vowels:
        count += 1
    for i in range(1, len(word)):
        if word[i] in vowels and word[i - 1] not in vowels:
            count += 1
    if word.endswith("e"):
        count -= 1
    if word.endswith("le") and len(word) > 2:
        count += 1
    if count == 0:
        count = 1
    return count

def flesch_reading_ease(text):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0.0
    sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
    sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
    if len(sentences) == 0:
        return 0.0
    syllable_count = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
    avg_syllables = syllable_count / len(words)
    avg_words_per_sentence = len(words) / len(sentences)
    score = 206.835 - 1.015 * avg_words_per_sentence - 84.6 * avg_syllables
    return max(0, min(100, score))

def automated_readability_index(text):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0.0
    sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
    sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
    if len(sentences) == 0:
        return 0.0
    char_count = sum(len(w) for w in words)
    ari = 4.71 * (char_count / len(words)) + 0.5 * (len(words) / len(sentences)) - 21.43
    return max(0, ari)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0] * 30)
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        sent_count = len(sentences) if len(sentences) > 0 else 1
        word_count = len(words)
        text_len = len(text)
        avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        avg_sent_len = word_count / sent_count
        upper_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        lower_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.islower()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        digit_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isdigit()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        whitespace_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isspace()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        punct_chars = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        punct_ratios = [
            text.count(p) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0 for p in punct_chars
        ]
        char_diversity = len(set(text.lower())) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        long_words_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        )
        capitalized_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isupper()) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        all_caps_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        sent_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
        sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0
        sent_len_var = np.var(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0
        words_lower = [w.lower() for w in words]
        function_word_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in FUNCTION_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        archaic_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        emotional_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        lovecraft_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        feat = [
            text_len,
            word_count,
            sent_count,
            avg_word_len,
            avg_sent_len,
            upper_ratio,
            lower_ratio,
            digit_ratio,
            whitespace_ratio,
            *punct_ratios,
            char_diversity,
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 2),
            long_words_ratio,
            capitalized_ratio,
            all_caps_ratio,
            sent_len_std,
            sent_len_var,
            function_word_ratio,
            archaic_ratio,
            emotional_ratio,
            lovecraft_ratio,
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)

def create_readability_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        flesch = flesch_reading_ease(text)
        ari = automated_readability_index(text)
        avg_syllables = np.mean([count_syllables(w) for w in words])
        complex_words = sum(1 for w in words if count_syllables(w) > 2)
        complex_ratio = complex_words / len(words)
        features.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_ratio])
    return np.array(features)

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    noun_suffixes = [
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ance",
        "ence",
        "ship",
        "dom",
        "hood",
    ]
    verb_suffixes = ["ed", "ing", "ate", "ize", "ify", "en", "ish"]
    adj_suffixes = [
        "ous",
        "ful",
        "ic",
        "al",
        "ive",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "less",
        "ish",
        "like",
    ]
    adv_suffixes = ["ly", "ward", "wise", "ways"]
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        noun_ratio = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in noun_suffixes)
        ) / len(words)
        verb_ratio = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in verb_suffixes)
        ) / len(words)
        adj_ratio = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in adj_suffixes)
        ) / len(words)
        adv_ratio = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in adv_suffixes)
        ) / len(words)
        words_lower = [w.lower() for w in words]
        content_words = [
            w for w in words_lower if len(w) > 3 and w not in FUNCTION_WORDS
        ]
        content_ratio = len(content_words) / len(words)
        features.append([noun_ratio, verb_ratio, adj_ratio, adv_ratio, content_ratio])
    return np.array(features)

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

import json
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

def extract_embeddings(model, all_ids, all_mask, batch_size):
    model.eval()

                    input_ids=input_ids,
                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                # Mean pooling of hidden states (excluding padding tokens)
                mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand(hidden_states.size()).float()
                sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
                sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1)
                sum_mask = torch.clamp(sum_mask, min=1e-9)
                mean_embeddings = (sum_embeddings / sum_mask).cpu().numpy()
            all_embeddings.append(mean_embeddings)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

def count_syllables(word):
    word = word.lower()
    count = 0
    vowels = "aeiouy"
    if word and word[0] in vowels:
        count += 1
    for i in range(1, len(word)):
        if word[i] in vowels and word[i - 1] not in vowels:
            count += 1
    if word.endswith("e"):
        count -= 1
    if word.endswith("le") and len(word) > 2:
        count += 1
    if count == 0:
        count = 1
    return count

def flesch_reading_ease(text):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0.0
    sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
    sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
    if len(sentences) == 0:
        return 0.0
    syllable_count = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
    avg_syllables = syllable_count / len(words)
    avg_words_per_sentence = len(words) / len(sentences)
    score = 206.835 - 1.015 * avg_words_per_sentence - 84.6 * avg_syllables
    return max(0, min(100, score))

def automated_readability_index(text):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0.0
    sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
    sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
    if len(sentences) == 0:
        return 0.0
    char_count = sum(len(w) for w in words)
    ari = 4.71 * (char_count / len(words)) + 0.5 * (len(words) / len(sentences)) - 21.43
    return max(0, ari)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    features = []

        text = str(text)

        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        sent_count = len(sentences) if len(sentences) > 0 else 1
        word_count = len(words)
        text_len = len(text)
        avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        avg_sent_len = word_count / sent_count
        upper_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        lower_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.islower()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        digit_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in text if c.isdigit()) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        )
        whitespace_ratio = (

        )
        punct_chars = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]

            text.count(p) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0 for p in punct_chars
        ]
        char_diversity = len(set(text.lower())) / text_len if text_len > 0 else 0
        long_words_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        )
        capitalized_ratio = (

        )
        all_caps_ratio = (

        )
        sent_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]

        sent_len_var = np.var(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0
        words_lower = [w.lower() for w in words]

            else 0
        )
        emotional_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        lovecraft_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words_lower if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        feat = [
            text_len,
            word_count,
            sent_count,
            avg_word_len,
            avg_sent_len,
            upper_ratio,
            lower_ratio,
            digit_ratio,
            whitespace_ratio,
            *punct_ratios,
            char_diversity,
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 2),
            long_words_ratio,

            all_caps_ratio,
            sent_len_std,
            sent_len_var,
            function_word_ratio,
            archaic_ratio,
            emotional_ratio,
            lovecraft_ratio,
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)

def create_readability_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text) or len(str(text).strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) == 0:

        flesch = flesch_reading_ease(text)

        complex_words = sum(1 for w in words if count_syllables(w) > 2)
        complex_ratio = complex_words / len(words)
        features.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_ratio])
    return np.array(features)

import json
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# Reusable evaluate function (no labels optional)
def evaluate_deberta_probs(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size):
    # Single deterministic forward pass (no MC Dropout)
    model.eval()
    all_probs = []
    dataset = TensorDataset(input_ids, attention_mask)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            b_input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(input_ids=b_input_ids, attention_mask=b_attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            all_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(all_probs)

def evaluate_deberta_with_labels(model, input_ids, attention_mask, labels, batch_size):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []
    dataset = TensorDataset(input_ids, attention_mask, labels)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            b_input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            b_attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            b_labels = batch[2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(input_ids=b_input_ids, attention_mask=b_attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            all_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(b_labels.cpu().numpy())
    all_preds = np.vstack(all_preds)
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)
    logloss = compute_log_loss(all_labels, all_preds)
    acc = np.mean(np.argmax(all_preds, axis=1) == all_labels)
    return logloss, acc, all_preds

    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {

            ],

        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()

        num_batches = 0
        for batch in train_loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
                )
                loss = outputs.loss
            if scaler_grad is not None:
                scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
                scaler_grad.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
            num_batches += 1
        avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches
        val_loss, val_acc, _ = evaluate_deberta_with_labels(

        if val_loss < best_val_loss:

        else:

    print(f"\nFold {fold+1} completed. Epochs trained: {NUM_EPOCHS}, Final val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}")

    # Load best model based on validation loss

def extract_embeddings(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=input_ids,
                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                # Mean pooling of hidden states (excluding padding tokens)
                mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand(hidden_states.size()).float()
                sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
                sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1)
                sum_mask = torch.clamp(sum_mask, min=1e-9)
                mean_embeddings = (sum_embeddings / sum_mask).cpu().numpy()
            all_embeddings.append(mean_embeddings)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

model_coefs = np.zeros(3)
for c in range(3):
    model_coefs[0] += coefs[c, 0:3].mean()
    model_coefs[1] += coefs[c, 3:6].mean()
    model_coefs[2] += coefs[c, 6:9].mean()
model_coefs /= 3  # average over classes

# Apply softmax to get weights
weights = np.exp(model_coefs) / np.exp(model_coefs).sum()
best_weights = {"deberta": weights[0], "xgboost": weights[1], "lr": weights[2]}

# Compute ensemble probabilities
ensemble_val_probs = (
    best_weights["deberta"] * val_probas["deberta"]
    + best_weights["xgboost"] * val_probas["xgboost"]
    + best_weights["lr"] * val_probas["lr"]
)
best_ll = compute_log_loss(y_val_labels, ensemble_val_probs)

print(f"Optimized ensemble weights (softmax of learned coefficients): {best_weights}")
print(f"Ensemble validation log loss: {best_ll:.4f}")

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
test_probas = {
    "deberta": deberta_test_probs,
    "xgboost": xgb_test_probs,
    "lr": lr_test_probs,
}
ensemble_test_probs = (
    best_weights["deberta"] * test_probas["deberta"]
    + best_weights["xgboost"] * test_probas["xgboost"]
    + best_weights["lr"] * test_probas["lr"]
)

eps = 1e-15
ensemble_test_probs = np.clip(ensemble_test_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
row_sums = ensemble_test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
ensemble_test_probs = ensemble_test_probs / row_sums
ensemble_test_probs = np.clip(ensemble_test_probs, eps, 1 - eps)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"].values,
        "EAP": ensemble_test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": ensemble_test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": ensemble_test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

submission_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_CSV, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {OUTPUT_CSV}")
print(submission_df.head())

# ============================================================
# FINAL VALIDATION SCORE
# ============================================================
print(f"Final Validation Score: {best_ll}")

gc.collect()
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

nodes.code_summary: The pipeline implements a multi-stage ensemble for Spooky Author Identification. It extracts handcrafted stylometric features (30-dim including punctuation ratios, character diversity, function/archaic/emotional/Lovecraft word ratios), readability features (Flesch Reading Ease, ARI, syllable counts), and POS tag approximations using suffix heuristics. TF-IDF character n-grams (2-4, 4-6, 5-7) and word n-grams (1-3) are extracted, along with punctuation sequence counts. A DeBERTa-v3-large model is fine-tuned using 5-fold cross-validation with linear schedule warmup and gradient clipping. DeBERTa embeddings are extracted via mean pooling of the last hidden state and averaged across folds. XGBoost is trained on the concatenation of stylometric, readability, POS, DeBERTa embeddings, and DeBERTa OOF probabilities. Logistic Regression is trained on sparse n-gram features. A final ensemble combines DeBERTa, XGBoost, and LR predictions using learned weights from a logistic regression trained on holdout validation probabilities.

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():

        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())

        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]

            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)

            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)

            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

# ============================================================
def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):

    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])

# HELPER: Mean pooling over non-padded tokens
# ============================================================
def mean_pool_embeddings(hidden_states, attention_mask):
    """Mean pool over all non-padded token vectors from the last hidden layer."""
    mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
    sum_embeddings = (hidden_states * mask).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
    seq_lengths = mask.sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 1)
    seq_lengths = seq_lengths.clamp(min=1e-9)
    return (sum_embeddings / seq_lengths).cpu().numpy()

# ============================================================
def fit_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Fit and return scaler for handcrafted features (no leakage)."""
    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)

    stylo, read, pos = extract_handcrafted_features(texts)
    hf = np.hstack([stylo, read, pos])
    return scaler.transform(hf)

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Compute log loss
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# HELPER: Extract mean-pooled embeddings from model
# ============================================================
def extract_mean_pooled_embeddings(model, input_ids, attention_mask, batch_size=32):
    """Extract mean-pooled embeddings over non-padded tokens."""
    model.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    n = input_ids.size(0)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, batch_size):
            batch_ids = input_ids[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            batch_mask = attention_mask[i:i+batch_size].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=batch_ids,
                    attention_mask=batch_mask,
                    output_hidden_states=True,
                )
                hidden = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
                pooled = mean_pool_embeddings(hidden, batch_mask)
            all_embeddings.append(pooled)
    return np.vstack(all_embeddings)

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

where N is the number of observations in the test set, M is the number of class labels (3 classes), \\(log\\) is the natural logarithm, \\(y_{ij}\\) is 1 if observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\) and 0 otherwise, and \\(p_{ij}\\) is the predicted probability that observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\).

The submitted probabilities for a given sentences are not required to sum to one because they are rescaled prior to being scored (each row is divided by the row sum). In order to avoid the extremes of the log function, predicted probabilities are replaced with \\(max(min(p,1-10^{-15}),10^{-15})\\).

The competition dataset contains text from works of fiction written by spooky authors of the public domain: Edgar Allan Poe, HP Lovecraft and Mary Shelley. The data was prepared by chunking larger texts into sentences using CoreNLP's MaxEnt sentence tokenizer, so you may notice the odd non-sentence here and there. Your objective is to accurately identify the author of the sentences in the test set.

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from a list/array of texts.
    Features: 0-11 basic stats, 12-23 punctuation ratios, 24-29 word ratios.
    """
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 30), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        text_len = len(text_str)
        features[i, 0] = text_len
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        features[i, 1] = word_count
        sent_pattern = r"[.!?]+"
        sents = re.split(sent_pattern, text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        features[i, 2] = sent_count
        if word_count > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / word_count
            features[i, 3] = avg_word_len
        features[i, 4] = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0
        unique_chars = len(set(text_str.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = unique_chars / max(text_len, 1)
        long_words_count = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
        features[i, 6] = long_words_count
        capitalized_count = 0
        for j, w in enumerate(words):
            if len(w) > 0 and w[0].isupper():
                if j > 0 and not words[j - 1].endswith((".", "!", "?")):
                    capitalized_count += 1
        features[i, 7] = capitalized_count
        all_caps_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and w.isupper() and w.isalpha()
        )
        features[i, 8] = all_caps_count
        sent_word_counts = []
        for sent in sents:
            sw = sent.split()
            if sw:
                sent_word_counts.append(len(sw))
        if len(sent_word_counts) > 1:
            features[i, 9] = np.std(sent_word_counts)
            features[i, 10] = np.var(sent_word_counts)
        digit_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c.isdigit())
        features[i, 11] = digit_count / max(text_len, 1)
        punct_marks = [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        for p_idx, p_mark in enumerate(punct_marks):
            p_count = text_str.count(p_mark)
            features[i, 12 + p_idx] = p_count / max(text_len, 1)
        lower_words = [w.lower().strip(string.punctuation) for w in words]
        lower_words = [w for w in lower_words if len(w) > 0]
        if len(lower_words) > 0:
            func_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in FUNCTION_WORDS)
            features[i, 24] = func_count / len(lower_words)
            archaic_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in ARCHAIC_WORDS)
            features[i, 25] = archaic_count / len(lower_words)
            emotional_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in EMOTIONAL_WORDS)
            features[i, 26] = emotional_count / len(lower_words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in LOVECRAFT_WORDS)
            features[i, 27] = lovecraft_count / len(lower_words)
            sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in lower_words if w in SUB_CONJ)
            features[i, 28] = sub_conj_count / len(lower_words)
            special_total = archaic_count + emotional_count + lovecraft_count
            features[i, 29] = special_total / len(lower_words)
    return features

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not word:
                return 0
            vowels = "aeiouy"
            vowel_groups = 0
            prev_is_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                is_vowel = char in vowels
                if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                    vowel_groups += 1
                prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            return vowel_groups

        total_syllables = 0
        complex_words = 0
        for word in words:
            syl_count = count_syllables(word)
            total_syllables += syl_count
            if syl_count >= 3:
                complex_words += 1
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / word_count
        sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
        sent_count = max(len(sents), 1)
        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0.0, min(flesch, 100.0))
        features[i, 0] = flesch
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            ari = (
                4.71 * (total_chars / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            ari = max(0.0, ari)
            features[i, 1] = ari
        features[i, 2] = avg_syllables
        features[i, 3] = complex_words / word_count
    return features

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns."""
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 5), dtype=np.float64)
    noun_suffixes = (
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ence",
        "ance",
        "ism",
        "ist",
        "ure",
        "age",
        "dom",
        "ship",
    )
    verb_suffixes = ("ed", "ing", "ate", "ify", "ize", "ise", "en", "ify")
    adj_suffixes = (
        "ous",
        "al",
        "able",
        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "ive",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "ish",
        "like",
        "y",
    )
    adv_suffixes = ("ly", "ward", "wise", "wards")
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            continue
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        if word_count == 0:
            continue
        noun_count = 0
        verb_count = 0
        adj_count = 0
        adv_count = 0
        content_word_count = 0
        for word in words:
            clean_word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not clean_word:
                continue
            if clean_word.endswith(noun_suffixes):
                noun_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(verb_suffixes):
                verb_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adj_suffixes):
                adj_count += 1
            if clean_word.endswith(adv_suffixes):
                adv_count += 1
            if clean_word not in FUNCTION_WORDS and len(clean_word) > 2:
                content_word_count += 1
        features[i, 0] = noun_count / word_count
        features[i, 1] = verb_count / word_count
        features[i, 2] = adj_count / word_count
        features[i, 3] = adv_count / word_count
        features[i, 4] = content_word_count / word_count
    return features

def extract_handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Extract all handcrafted features for a set of texts."""
    stylo = extract_stylometric_features(texts)
    read = create_readability_features(texts)
    pos = create_pos_tag_approximation(texts)
    return stylo, read, pos

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation])
